name: base-clasp-ts
description: repo base para trabajar con clasp y typescript

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('src/appsscript.json')) fs.copyFileSync('src/appsscript.json', 'dist/appsscript.json');"
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:clean && pnpm clasp:config && clasp push
